name: fieldproof-sample-plots
description: Public sample plots for the Krishyak FieldProof demo. Salts are public demo values; real deployments keep the salt with the farmer.

properties.name: Ludhiana sample plot
properties.regional_context: Irrigated double-cropping region (rice in kharif and wheat in rabi are typical). Useful as a contrast: irrigation buffers rainfall deficits.
properties.boundary_note: Approximate polygon drawn over cropland visible in Sentinel-2 imagery for this demo. Not a registered farmer field; the crop grown is not verified.

properties.name: Kotputli sample plot
properties.regional_context: Semi-arid north-east Rajasthan. Kharif crops are mostly rainfed (pearl millet is typical); rabi wheat or mustard relies on groundwater.
properties.boundary_note: Approximate polygon drawn over cropland visible in Sentinel-2 imagery for this demo. Not a registered farmer field; the crop grown is not verified.

properties.name: Latur sample plot
properties.regional_context: Marathwada: drought-prone and largely rainfed (soybean and pigeon pea are typical kharif crops).
properties.boundary_note: Approximate polygon drawn over cropland visible in Sentinel-2 imagery for this demo. Not a registered farmer field; the crop grown is not verified.

properties.name: Anantapur sample plot
properties.regional_context: One of India's most drought-prone districts; rainfed groundnut is the typical kharif crop.
properties.boundary_note: Approximate polygon drawn over cropland visible in Sentinel-2 imagery for this demo. Not a registered farmer field; the crop grown is not verified.
